title: UP Police OTR Registration 2025
organization: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
postName: One Time Registration (OTR) for UP Police Recruitments
vacancyDetails: Mandatory OTR profile for applying to UP Police SI, Constable and other UPPRPB recruitments
qualification: As per future UP Police post notifications; OTR is registration only
ageLimit: As applicable when applying to specific posts
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppbpb.gov.in
2. Open One Time Registration / Candidate Registration
3. Create account with mobile and email
4. Fill personal, educational and photo details
5. Save OTR ID for all future UP Police applications
shortDescription: UP Police OTR Registration 2025 – complete One Time Registration on uppbpb.gov.in before applying to SI/Constable exams.
content:
UPPRPB requires candidates to complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the official portal before applying for most Uttar Pradesh Police recruitments.

OTR stores basic profile, photo and educational data. Use the same credentials for SI, Constable, ASI and other notifications.

Portal: uppbpb.gov.in. Keep Aadhaar, photo and educational certificates ready while registering.
